# Layout/Card / Two Column

Projects independent left and right regions into a configurable two-column card. The columns stack at the selected container breakpoint.

## Overrides

```ts
{
    layout: "split",
    showHeader: false,
    splitLeftWidth: "34%",
    splitRightWidth: "1fr",
    splitDivider: true,
  }
```
